name: Fighting Frenzy [Combat, Teamwork]
body:
You feed off the rage of your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, rage or similar class feature (like bloodrage).

Benefit(s): When you and an ally within 60 feet are in a rage, neither of you take the normal –2 penalty to AC for being in a rage. If either of you would take a larger penalty to AC for being in a rage, reduce that penalty by 2.
